When you use a different
version of Android Studio

entries.source: Androidの教科書はPanda 2を基準にしています。Quail 4・Panda 3を使う人は、作り始める前にこのページで、自分の版と進め方を確かめます。
entries.translation: The Android textbooks are based on Panda 2. If you use Quail 4 or Panda 3, check your version and how to proceed on this page before you start building.

entries.source: 対象は後半のAndroid単元です。前半のK01HelloKotlinで使うIntelliJ IDEAの設定は変えません。
entries.translation: This page is for the Android units in the second part. The IntelliJ IDEA settings you use for K01HelloKotlin in the first part stay the same.

entries.source: 1. 版を確かめる・サポートの範囲
entries.translation: 1. Check your version and the scope of support

entries.source: Welcome画面、またはmacOSの Android Studio → About Android Studio で、製品名と版を見ます。Panda 2・Panda 3・Quail 4 の名前まで確認します。
entries.translation: Check the product name and version on the Welcome screen, or with Android Studio → About Android Studio in the macOS menu bar. Check the name too, such as Panda 2, Panda 3, or Quail 4.

entries.source: 使っている版
entries.translation: Version you use

entries.source: 進め方
entries.translation: How to proceed

entries.source: 授業の基準です。教科書の手順どおり進めます。作成日でライブラリの版が変わるため、A01のSTEP 01にある設定の照合も行います。
entries.translation: This is the standard version for the class. Follow the textbook steps as written. Library versions change depending on the creation date, so also do the settings check in STEP 01 of A01.

entries.source: このページのA01の読み替えに従います。下の表と設定が一致し、同期・Runが通る範囲で進めます。表にない違いやエラーは先生に見せます。
entries.translation: Follow the A01 adaptations on this page. Continue as long as your settings match the table below and sync and Run succeed. Show your teacher any differences or errors that are not in the table.

entries.source: 実測していません。Panda 2の手順を出発点にしますが、同じように動くと確認済みではありません。A01のSTEP 00で版を先生に見せ、STEP 01の設定全文を置き換える前に確認します。画面や生成設定が違ったら、そのまま先生に見せます。
entries.translation: Not tested. Use the Panda 2 steps as a starting point, but it has not been confirmed that they work the same way. Show your teacher your version in STEP 00 of A01, and check before you replace the whole settings file in STEP 01. If the screens or generated settings are different, show them to your teacher as they are.

entries.source: 上記以外・版が分からない
entries.translation: Any other version, or you do not know your version

entries.source: 新規作成や設定の変更を始める前に先生へ相談します。この資料で動作を確認した範囲には含みません。
entries.translation: Talk to your teacher before you create a new project or change any settings. This is outside what this guide has tested.

entries.source: 授業ではmacOSを使います。見た目や項目の位置だけの違いは、次の表の選択内容で合わせます。必要な項目が見つからない、同期が赤い、Runできない場合は、設定を次々と変更せず先生と確認します。基準のPanda 2へ切り替えるかも、その場で決めます。
entries.translation: The class uses macOS. If only the appearance or the position of items is different, match the selections in the next table. If you cannot find an item you need, sync shows red errors, or you cannot Run, do not keep changing settings one after another; check with your teacher. Whether to switch to Panda 2, the standard version, is also decided at that point.

entries.source: 2. 新規作成で合わせる項目
entries.translation: 2. Items to match when creating a new project

entries.source: New Projectの画面では、位置より選ぶ内容を合わせます。A01では次のとおりです。
entries.translation: On the New Project screen, match what you select rather than where things are. For A01, it is as follows.

entries.source: 項目
entries.translation: Field

entries.source: A01で選ぶ内容
entries.translation: What to select for A01

entries.source: テンプレート
entries.translation: Template

entries.source: Phone and Tablet → Empty Views Activity。ViewsのないEmpty Activityは選びません。
entries.translation: Phone and Tablet → Empty Views Activity. Do not select Empty Activity (the one without "Views").

entries.source: 自分の Documents/Kotlin/A01HelloAndroid。末尾のプロジェクト名まで含めます。
entries.translation: Your own Documents/Kotlin/A01HelloAndroid. Include the project name at the end.

entries.source: API 31（Android 12）。下のtargetSdkとは別の項目です。
entries.translation: API 31 (Android 12). This is a different setting from targetSdk below.

entries.source: 実行先の表示名は、版が違っても jec_25cm_kotlin_Pixel 9a です。Device Managerに既にあれば、その端末を使います。なければA01のSTEP 02で先生が指定するシステムイメージを使って作ります。実機が接続されている場合も、Runの実行先が指定AVDになっているか確かめます。
entries.translation: The display name of the device to run on is jec_25cm_kotlin_Pixel 9a, even with a different version. If it already exists in Device Manager, use that device. If not, create it in STEP 02 of A01 using the system image your teacher specifies. Even when a physical device is connected, check that the Run target is the designated AVD.

entries.source: POINT：IDEの版とプロジェクトの設定は別
entries.translation: POINT: The IDE version and the project settings are separate

entries.source: Quail 4でPanda 2の完成見本をOpenしても、見本のAGPやGradleをQuail 4の値へ変更する必要はありません。更新をすすめるAGP Upgrade Assistantは閉じ、配布された設定を保って照合します。
entries.translation: Even if you open the Panda 2 completed sample with Open in Quail 4, you do not need to change the sample's AGP or Gradle to Quail 4's values. Close the AGP Upgrade Assistant, which suggests upgrading, and keep the distributed settings when you compare.

entries.source: 3. Quail 4でのA01の読み替え
entries.translation: 3. Adapting A01 for Quail 4

entries.source: 対象は A01HelloAndroid のSTEP 00〜13です。先生に版を見せたあと、次の表を手元に置いて進めます。
entries.translation: This covers STEP 00–13 of A01HelloAndroid. After you show your teacher your version, keep the following table at hand as you work.

entries.source: 教科書の場所
entries.translation: Place in the textbook

entries.source: Quail 4で行うこと
entries.translation: What to do in Quail 4

entries.source: 上の6項目で自分のプロジェクトを作ります。画面の順序が違っても、Empty Views Activity・Kotlin・API 31・Kotlin DSLを合わせます。
entries.translation: Create your own project with the six items above. Even if the order on the screen is different, match Empty Views Activity, Kotlin, API 31, and Kotlin DSL.

entries.source: STEP 01：libs.versions.toml全文の置き換え
entries.translation: STEP 01: Replacing the whole libs.versions.toml

entries.source: この置き換えは行いません。Quail 4が作った gradle/libs.versions.toml とビルド設定をセットで保ち、次の差分表と照合します。Panda 2のAGP 9.1.1だけを入れると、Quail 4の optimization の書き方と合いません。既に置き換えた場合は先生に見せます。
entries.translation: Do not do this replacement. Keep the gradle/libs.versions.toml and build settings that Quail 4 created together as a set, and compare them with the table of differences below. If you bring in only Panda 2's AGP 9.1.1, it does not match the way Quail 4 writes optimization. If you have already replaced it, show your teacher.

entries.source: STEP 02〜03：端末・初回Run
entries.translation: STEP 02–03: Device and first Run

entries.source: 指定AVDを選び、生成直後の Hello World! を確かめます。SDKやJDKのダウンロード中は進行表示を確認します。
entries.translation: Select the designated AVD and check the Hello World! shown right after the project is generated. While the SDK or JDK is downloading, watch the progress display.

entries.source: 教科書のXML全文を使います。main・text・button・btn1・btn2 のidを変えません。
entries.translation: Use the full XML from the textbook. Do not change the ids main, text, button, btn1, or btn2.

entries.source: STEP 05〜10：Kotlinの処理を追加
entries.translation: STEP 05–10: Adding Kotlin logic

entries.source: 教科書と同じコードを入力します。生成された余白処理は残し、onCreate の中へ追加します。文字変更・Snackbar・Toast・Logcatの確認結果は同じです。
entries.translation: Type the same code as in the textbook. Keep the generated padding code, and add your code inside onCreate. The results you check for the text change, Snackbar, Toast, and Logcat are the same.

entries.source: STEP 11〜13：全文照合・アレンジ
entries.translation: STEP 11–13: Full comparison and customization

entries.source: 教科書の MainActivity.kt 全文とXMLを照合します。比較するのはこの2ファイルで、Quail 4のGradle設定全体を完成見本から上書きしません。文字と余白のアレンジは同じ場所です。
entries.translation: Compare your code with the full MainActivity.kt and the XML in the textbook. Compare only these two files; do not overwrite all of Quail 4's Gradle settings with those from the completed sample. Text and spacing customizations are in the same places.

entries.source: 完成見本は samples/A01HelloAndroid です。別ウィンドウで開いて比べ、入力を続けるときは自分の Documents/Kotlin/A01HelloAndroid へ戻ります。完成見本は自分の提出作品として扱いません。
entries.translation: The completed sample is samples/A01HelloAndroid. Open it in a separate window to compare, and go back to your own Documents/Kotlin/A01HelloAndroid when you continue typing. The completed sample does not count as your own work for submission.

entries.source: 4. 生成される設定の違い
entries.translation: 4. Differences in generated settings

entries.source: 左のProjectツールウィンドウを Project 表示にすると、次のファイルを開けます。これは見比べる表で、値を書き換える一覧ではありません。Panda 2列は教材のひな形・完成版、Quail 4列は比較用ひな形の実測値です。
entries.translation: Switch the Project tool window on the left to the Project view, and you can open the following files. This is a table for comparing, not a list of values to rewrite. The Panda 2 column shows the course's template project and completed version; the Quail 4 column shows the actual values in the template project used for comparison.

entries.source: 見る場所
entries.translation: Where to look

entries.source: Panda 2：教材の基準
entries.translation: Panda 2: Course standard

entries.source: Quail 4：保つ設定
entries.translation: Quail 4: Settings to keep

entries.source: app/build.gradle.kts のcompileSdk
entries.translation: compileSdk in app/build.gradle.kts

entries.source: 同じファイルのtargetSdk
entries.translation: targetSdk in the same file

entries.source: 同じファイルのbuildTypes → release
entries.translation: buildTypes → release in the same file

entries.source: isMinifyEnabled = false と proguardFiles(...)
entries.translation: isMinifyEnabled = false and proguardFiles(...)

entries.source: R8のkeepルールのファイル
entries.translation: R8 keep rules file

entries.translation: distributionUrl in gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties

entries.source: gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties のtoolchainVersion
entries.translation: toolchainVersion in gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties

entries.source: configuration-cacheの指定なし
entries.translation: No configuration-cache setting

entries.source: Quail 4の app/build.gradle.kts では、依存の名前も libs.androidx.activity.ktx です。Panda 2のカタログへ丸ごと置き換えると、この名前も合わなくなります。表にない版が生成された場合は、自分で表の数値へ直さず先生と確認します。
entries.translation: In Quail 4's app/build.gradle.kts, the dependency name is also libs.androidx.activity.ktx. If you replace the whole catalog with Panda 2's, this name no longer matches either. If versions that are not in the table are generated, do not change them to the numbers in the table yourself; check with your teacher.

entries.source: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml のActivityに、Quail 4では android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize" も生成されています。A01の作業ではそのまま残します。Kotlinの MainActivity.kt はパッケージ名を除いて、生成直後のXMLは全文が、2つのひな形で一致していました。
entries.translation: In Quail 4, android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize" is also generated for the Activity in app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Leave it as it is when you work on A01. In the two template projects, the Kotlin MainActivity.kt matched except for the package name, and the XML right after generation matched in full.

entries.source: JDKの21と25で、Kotlinの書き方は変わるか
entries.translation: Does JDK 21 or 25 change how you write Kotlin?

entries.source: toolchainVersion はアプリを組み立てるGradleを動かすJava実行環境の指定です。学生が書くKotlinの文法の版ではありません。Java側の compileOptions は、どちらのひな形も JavaVersion.VERSION_11 です。Swiftでも、IDEを動かす環境の版と、ソースで使う言語の設定を分けて考えるのと同じです。
entries.translation: toolchainVersion specifies the Java runtime that runs Gradle, which builds the app. It is not the version of the Kotlin syntax that students write. On the Java side, compileOptions is JavaVersion.VERSION_11 in both template projects. It is the same as in Swift, where you think about the version of the environment that runs the IDE separately from the language settings used in your source code.

entries.source: 必要なJDKがMacにない場合、設定されたダウンロード先から取得することがあります。Downloading などの進行表示が出ていれば待ちます。赤いエラーで止まったら、JDKの数字を変更せず、その表示を先生に見せます。
entries.translation: If the JDK you need is not on your Mac, it may be downloaded from the configured download location. If a progress display such as Downloading appears, wait. If it stops with a red error, do not change the JDK number; show that message to your teacher.

entries.source: 5. 止まったとき
entries.translation: 5. If you get stuck

entries.source: 画面で起きたこと
entries.translation: What happened on the screen

entries.source: すること
entries.translation: What to do

entries.source: ボタンの位置やメニュー名が違う
entries.translation: Button positions or menu names are different

entries.source: 選択内容を2節で照合。Empty Views Activityなど必要な項目が見つからなければ先生に見せます。
entries.translation: Check your selections against section 2. If you cannot find a required item such as Empty Views Activity, show your teacher.

entries.source: optimization や activity.ktx が赤い
entries.translation: optimization or activity.ktx is red

entries.source: Panda 2とQuail 4の設定を混ぜた可能性があります。最近置き換えたファイルとエラーを先生に見せます。片方ずつ版を下げて試しません。
entries.translation: You may have mixed Panda 2 and Quail 4 settings. Show your teacher the files you recently replaced and the error. Do not experiment by lowering versions one at a time.

entries.source: Gradle同期やSDK・JDKの取得が失敗した
entries.translation: Gradle sync or downloading the SDK or JDK failed

entries.source: エラーの先頭を表示し、先生に見せます。通信・必要なSDK・プロジェクトの生成版を確認します。
entries.translation: Display the beginning of the error and show it to your teacher. Check the network connection, the required SDK, and the version the project was generated with.

entries.source: ビルドは通るが、A01の画面が違う・閉じる
entries.translation: The build succeeds, but the A01 screen is different or the app closes

entries.source: XMLのidとKotlinのR.id、指定AVDを確認します。直らなければSTEP番号とLogcatの赤い行を先生に見せます。
entries.translation: Check the ids in the XML, R.id in Kotlin, and the designated AVD. If that does not fix it, show your teacher the STEP number and the red lines in Logcat.

entries.source: Panda 2へ切り替えることになった
entries.translation: You need to switch to Panda 2

entries.source: 自作プロジェクトを消さずに残します。先生と保存先を分け、Panda 2で作った新しいプロジェクトへ、自分のXMLとKotlinを照合して移します。Quail 4のGradle設定は持ち込みません。
entries.translation: Keep your own project; do not delete it. With your teacher, use a separate save location, and move your XML and Kotlin into a new project created in Panda 2, comparing them as you go. Do not bring over Quail 4's Gradle settings.

entries.source: 相談するときは Studioの製品名と版・教材のVERSION.jsonにある版・単元とSTEP番号・エラーの先頭を見せます。実習時間内に原因を切り分けられない場合もあるため、止まった時点で声をかけてください。
entries.translation: When you ask for help, show the Studio product name and version, the version in the materials' VERSION.json, the unit and STEP number, and the beginning of the error. The cause may not be found within class time, so speak up as soon as you get stuck.

entries.source: 教材の開き方は <a1>共通：はじめの準備</a1>、提出時の作業は <a2>共通：提出課題とAPK</a2> にあります。
entries.translation: How to open the materials is in <a1>Shared: Getting ready for class</a1>, and what to do when you submit is in <a2>Shared: The assignment and the APK</a2>.

entries.source: 2026年9月24日、教材のPanda 2とQuail 4のKotlinひな形を比較しました。表の値はそのファイルに基づきます。作成日によって値が変わる場合があります。
entries.translation: On September 24, 2026, the Panda 2 and Quail 4 Kotlin template projects in the materials were compared. The values in the tables are based on those files. Values may change depending on the creation date.

entries.source: Quail 4構成でのビルド
entries.translation: Build with the Quail 4 setup

entries.source: ひな形を別の検証用フォルダに複製し、設定を保ったまま、生成直後とA01のSTEP 04・05・08・09・10〜11に相当するコードで assembleDebug の成功を確認しました。検証コピーではパッケージ名だけをひな形に合わせています。
entries.translation: The template project was duplicated into a separate test folder. With its settings kept as they were, assembleDebug was confirmed to succeed both right after generation and with code equivalent to STEP 04, 05, 08, 09, and 10–11 of A01. In the test copy, only the package name was changed to match the template project.

entries.source: Quail 4構成での実行
entries.translation: Run with the Quail 4 setup

entries.source: 上の検証コピーの完成コードを指定AVD jec_25cm_kotlin_Pixel 9a（API 37.1）で実行し、文字変更、1のSnackbar、2のToast、起動時とクリック後のLogcatを確認しました。
entries.translation: The completed code in the test copy above was run on the designated AVD jec_25cm_kotlin_Pixel 9a (API 37.1), and the text change, the Snackbar for button 1, the Toast for button 2, and Logcat at startup and after a click were confirmed.

entries.source: ここでは未確認
entries.translation: Not verified here

entries.source: Quail 4の現在のIDE画面のメニュー位置、Panda 3、ほかのStudio版、今後教材化するA02以降の段階別コード。これらも確認済みとは扱いません。
entries.translation: Menu positions in the current Quail 4 IDE screens, Panda 3, other Studio versions, and the step-by-step code for A02 and later units, which will be turned into materials in the future. These are not treated as verified either.

entries.source: Quail 4の設定に書き換えた完成見本を配ることはしません。配布する完成見本と教科書本文の基準はPanda 2です。
entries.translation: Completed samples rewritten for Quail 4 settings are not distributed. The distributed completed samples and the textbook text are based on Panda 2.
